name: launch-swarm
description: Product-launch swarm: strategy (top reasoning model), copy (explicit model), art direction (vision model) run in parallel, merged by a synthesizer.

tasks.label: strategy
tasks.task: Draft the go-to-market strategy for the product in the user's request: positioning, pricing, launch channels, and a 30-day timeline.

tasks.label: copy
tasks.task: Write the landing-page copy for the product in the user's request: hero headline, three benefit blocks, and a CTA.

tasks.label: art
tasks.task: Describe the hero illustration and overall visual direction for the product in the user's request.

name: research-swarm
description: Parallel research squad returning structured JSON records per task — for programmatic consumption (agents, pipelines).

tasks.label: summary
tasks.task: Summarize the user's material into five bullet points.

tasks.label: entities
tasks.task: Extract every person, company, product and date mentioned, as a plain list.

tasks.label: critique
tasks.task: Red-team the user's material: weakest claims, missing evidence, counterarguments.

name: dev-squad
description: Coding squad: architect plans, coder drafts, reviewer critiques — all in parallel, one synthesized answer.

tasks.label: architect
tasks.task: Propose an implementation plan (files, interfaces, edge cases) for the user's request. Do not write the full code.

tasks.label: coder
tasks.task: Write the core code for the user's request. Focus on the happy path plus the two most likely failure modes.

tasks.label: reviewer
tasks.task: Review the user's request as a staff engineer: list security, performance and correctness concerns a naive implementation would hit.

name: ad-hoc-swarm
description: Minimal swarm used with per-request tasks: send `body.swarm.tasks` on each call to fan any workload out to tag-picked specialists. Replace these placeholder tasks with your own at request time.

tasks.label: one
tasks.task: First subtask — overridden by body.swarm.tasks on each request.

tasks.label: two
tasks.task: Second subtask — overridden by body.swarm.tasks on each request.
